name: 孵化
desc: ①：把自己场上1只怪兽解放才能发动。比解放的怪兽等级高1星的1只昆虫族怪兽从卡组特殊召唤。
errata: Tribute 1 monster on your side of the field. Select 1 Insect-Type monster from your Deck that is 1 Level higher than the Tributed monster and Special Summon it on your side of the field in face-up Attack Position or face-down Defense Position. Then shuffle your Deck.
